region: US
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Localized Tornado Outbreak at the Upstream of a Tropical Easterly Wave in Camarines Norte, Philippines (13 September 2025)
method: Tropical case analysis
inputs: Weather observations and environmental analysis
target_and_horizon: Philippines tornado outbreak; case study
summary: Adds a tropical, non-US case to the geographic research map.
summary_zh: 补入菲律宾热带环境个例，提醒区域龙卷机制不应只套用美国大平原范式。
region: Philippines
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Weather-R1: Logically Consistent Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Multimodal Reasoning in Meteorology
method: Reinforcement fine-tuning; VLM
inputs: Meteorological images and questions
target_and_horizon: Meteorological reasoning consistency
summary: A transferable reasoning-training method, not established tornado-detection evidence.
summary_zh: 提供逻辑一致性的强化微调思路，但尚不能当成龙卷检测有效性的证据。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Its WeatherQA is a different benchmark from Ma et al. (2024). Reinforcement fine-tuning is not the same task as adaptive radar scanning or operational tornado-warning control. Conference status checked against the official ICASSP 2026 accepted-paper program (paper 9095); final proceedings DOI not verified.

title: Skilful precipitation nowcasting using deep generative models of radar
method: Deep generative radar nowcasting
inputs: Weather radar
target_and_horizon: Precipitation nowcasting
summary: A transferable generative forecasting and human-evaluation reference.
summary_zh: 生成式雷达临近预报与人工评价的参考路线；降水技巧不代表龙卷预报技巧。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Precipitation-field skill is not tornado-event skill. The linked release supplies pretrained generative models; existence of this repository is not a verification of a complete reproducible training pipeline.

title: Skilful nowcasting of extreme precipitation with NowcastNet
method: Physics-conditioned generative modeling
inputs: Radar precipitation fields
target_and_horizon: Extreme-precipitation nowcasting
summary: A transfer-method reference for combining physical constraints with generative prediction.
summary_zh: 物理约束与生成模型融合的参考，不将强降水预测包装成龙卷发生预测。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Extreme-precipitation nowcasting is a transfer method, not tornado validation. The author-linked code and pretrained weights are a Code Ocean capsule, not an identified official GitHub repository. No independent reproduction was performed. The DOI resolves to Code Ocean capsule 3935105; automated retrieval returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-29, so capsule execution/download was not verified.

title: ClimaX: A foundation model for weather and climate
method: Transformer foundation model
inputs: Heterogeneous weather/climate variables
target_and_horizon: General weather and climate transfer
summary: Read for variable-aware pretraining and adaptation across datasets.
summary_zh: 变量感知预训练与跨数据集迁移的参考，不宣称能直接解析龙卷尺度。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: WeatherBench: A benchmark data set for data-driven weather forecasting
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
method: Benchmark design
inputs: Global reanalysis fields
target_and_horizon: Global weather forecasting evaluation
summary: A benchmark-design reference, not a tornado dataset.
summary_zh: 学习公开基准、数据划分与基线设计；它不是龙卷数据集。
region: Global
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: WeatherBench 2: A Benchmark for the Next Generation of Data-Driven Global Weather Models
venue: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
method: Multi-metric forecast benchmark
inputs: Global forecasts and reference fields
target_and_horizon: Medium-range global forecasting evaluation
summary: Read for metric design, baselines and reproducible forecast comparison.
summary_zh: 学习多指标、强基线与可复现比较，不把全球天气榜单当作龙卷模型榜单。
region: Global
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Challenges and Benchmark Datasets for Machine Learning in the Atmospheric Sciences: Definition, Status, and Outlook
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
method: Benchmark methodology review
inputs: Atmospheric ML benchmark literature
target_and_horizon: Dataset and evaluation design
summary: A methods reference for designing defensible atmospheric benchmarks.
summary_zh: 为龙卷基准设计提供方法论参考：先定义任务与观测，再组织指标。
region: Unspecified

title: A Machine Learning Tutorial for Operational Meteorology. Part II: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
method: Tutorial
inputs: Meteorological examples
target_and_horizon: Neural-network and deep-learning education
summary: An accessible bridge for meteorologists entering deep learning.
summary_zh: 为从气象业务进入深度学习的读者提供基础概念和实践入口。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Non-supercell Tornadoes
method: Observational mechanism study
inputs: Storm observations
target_and_horizon: Nonsupercell tornadogenesis
summary: Broadens the physical map beyond supercell tornadoes.
summary_zh: 补齐非超级单体龙卷机制，避免用中气旋思路解释所有龙卷。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: A Climatology of Tornadoes in Europe: Results from the European Severe Weather Database
method: Climatology
inputs: European Severe Weather Database
target_and_horizon: European tornado climatology
summary: A regional baseline with reporting-coverage considerations.
summary_zh: 欧洲龙卷气候统计与报告覆盖，为跨区域泛化研究提供参照。
region: Europe
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Tornado climatology of China
method: Historical-event climatology
inputs: Compiled Chinese tornado records
target_and_horizon: Chinese tornado climatology
summary: A core regional-climatology reference; reporting incompleteness remains important.
summary_zh: 中国龙卷气候统计的重要文献，记录完整性与采集口径影响所有下游分析。
region: China
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Climatology of tropical cyclone tornadoes in China from 2006 to 2018
method: Tropical-cyclone tornado climatology
inputs: Tropical cyclone and tornado observations
target_and_horizon: Tropical cyclone tornado environments
summary: Separates tropical-cyclone tornado environments from other tornado regimes.
summary_zh: 补齐中国台风龙卷分支，不能简单与大陆超级单体场景混为一谈。
region: China
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: The Tornado Archive: Compiling and Visualizing a Worldwide, Digitized Tornado Database
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Global data curation and visualization
inputs: Multi-source tornado reports
target_and_horizon: Worldwide event archive
summary: A reference for reconciling heterogeneous tornado records across the world.
summary_zh: 全球龙卷事件汇编与可视化，为事件去重、来源追踪和跨区域数据整理提供参考。
region: Global
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: The Propagation, Evolution, and Rotation in Linear Storms (PERiLS) Project
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Field observation campaign
inputs: Multi-instrument observations of QLCSs
target_and_horizon: QLCS tornadogenesis and evolution
summary: An observation-focused entry for tornadoes embedded in linear convective systems.
summary_zh: 面向准线性对流系统的观测实验，补齐 QLCS 龙卷及多传感器观测分支。
region: US
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting
method: Graph neural network; GraphCast
inputs: Global reanalysis
target_and_horizon: Medium-range global weather
summary: A graph-based Earth-system modeling reference, not a resolved tornado model.
summary_zh: 图神经网络全球天气预报代表方法，可借鉴结构，但不等于能解析龙卷。
region: Global
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited. The original author-linked GraphCast repository now redirects to google-deepmind/weathernext; select the GraphCast implementation/version within that evolving project.

title: A foundation model for the Earth system
method: Earth-system foundation model; Aurora
inputs: Diverse Earth-system data
target_and_horizon: Multiple Earth-system forecast tasks
summary: An adaptable foundation-model design to consider for transfer research.
summary_zh: 地球系统基础模型的迁移设计参考；不把其通用能力当作龙卷任务实验证据。
region: Global
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: HRRRCast: A Data-Driven Emulator for Regional Weather Forecasting at Convection-Allowing Scales
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
method: ResNet; graph model; diffusion ensembles
inputs: HRRR and large-scale forecast states
target_and_horizon: Regional convection-allowing weather emulation
summary: Extends the repository to regional learned emulators relevant to storm evolution.
summary_zh: 面向允许对流尺度的区域学习式模拟；回波预报改善不能直接外推为龙卷发生预测改善。
region: US
caveat: Regional weather emulation does not establish tornado-event prediction skill. Linked NOAA repository documents a live inference pipeline; this catalog does not certify a complete training reproduction. Metadata/abstract-level review only.

title: Estimates of Gradients in Radar Moments Using a Linear Least Squares Derivative Technique
method: Linear least-squares derivatives
inputs: Radar moments
target_and_horizon: Radar gradient estimation
summary: A feature-engineering reference for physically interpretable radar gradients.
summary_zh: 雷达矩梯度估计的基础方法，适合研究方位切变等可解释特征。
region: Unspecified
caveat: Bibliographic/abstract-level seed annotation; full-text methods, splits and performance have not been independently audited.

title: Airflow and Structure of a Tornadic Storm
method: Storm airflow reconstruction
inputs: Radar and storm observations
target_and_horizon: Tornadic-storm structure; retrospective
summary: Reconstructs airflow and storm structure to connect the parent thunderstorm with the tornado, providing a physical interpretation of observed radar morphology.
summary_zh: 通过风暴观测重建气流与结构，将龙卷放回母体雷暴中理解，为解释雷达回波形态提供物理背景。
region: United States
caveat: A storm-structure case study is not an automated detection benchmark. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Vortex Signature Recognition by a Doppler Radar
method: Doppler vortex-signature recognition
inputs: Doppler radial velocity
target_and_horizon: Recognition of a radar vortex signature
summary: Develops Doppler-radar recognition of vortex signatures, linking measured velocity patterns to rotating storms before modern operational algorithms.
summary_zh: 研究如何从多普勒径向速度中识别涡旋特征，连接早期旋转风暴观测与后来的业务检测算法。
region: United States
caveat: Radar rotation is not by itself confirmation of a ground-contact tornado. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Tornadoes and Downbursts in the Context of Generalized Planetary Scales
method: Scale classification and observational synthesis
inputs: Storm analyses and aerial damage photography
target_and_horizon: Classification of tornado and downburst flow scales; retrospective
summary: Places tornadoes and downbursts in a hierarchy of atmospheric motion scales using storm analysis and aerial evidence of wind effects.
summary_zh: 结合风暴分析和航空灾损照片讨论龙卷、下击暴流及其母体系统的尺度关系，帮助区分不同强风现象。
region: United States
caveat: A scale taxonomy does not make tornado and downburst labels interchangeable. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Exploration of Certain Features of Tornado Dynamics Using a Laboratory Model
method: Laboratory vortex simulation
inputs: Controlled inflow, updraft and vortex geometry
target_and_horizon: Tornado-like vortex structure; laboratory experiment
summary: Uses a laboratory vortex to investigate pressure profiles, core deformation and multiple vortices under controlled flow geometry.
summary_zh: 在实验室中控制入流和上升气流，研究压强分布、涡核变形与多涡旋结构，是理解龙卷模拟装置的基础文献。
region: Laboratory
caveat: A laboratory vortex represents selected flow processes, not a complete parent thunderstorm. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Study in Tornado-Like Vortex Dynamics
method: Numerical vortex dynamics
inputs: Idealized tornado-like flow
target_and_horizon: Vortex structure and dynamics; simulation
summary: Investigates tornado-like vortex dynamics numerically, forming part of the classical connection between laboratory vortices and fluid-dynamical models.
summary_zh: 利用数值模型研究类龙卷涡旋动力学，补足实验室涡旋与流体动力学理论之间的经典研究脉络。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Interpret results within the model geometry and boundary conditions. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Characteristics of Tornado-Like Vortices as a Function of Swirl Ratio: A Laboratory Investigation
method: Laboratory swirl-ratio experiments
inputs: Ward-type simulator and velocity measurements
target_and_horizon: Single- and multiple-vortex regimes; laboratory experiment
summary: Examines changes in vortex structure as swirl ratio and other flow parameters vary, including vortex breakdown and multiple-vortex configurations.
summary_zh: 通过改变旋流比等控制参数，观察单涡旋、涡旋破裂及多涡旋结构，说明不同流态不能用一种固定漏斗形状概括。
region: Laboratory
caveat: Swirl-ratio definitions and simulator geometry matter when comparing studies. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Streamwise Vorticity: The Origin of Updraft Rotation in Supercell Storms
method: Linear vorticity theory
inputs: Idealized sheared environmental flow
target_and_horizon: Origin of supercell updraft rotation
summary: Relates streamwise environmental vorticity to rotation within a convective updraft, establishing a physical basis for storm-relative helicity reasoning.
summary_zh: 从理论上联系环境顺流涡度与对流上升气流旋转，为理解风暴相对螺旋度及超级单体旋转提供基础。
region: Idealized theory
caveat: Updraft rotation is a parent-storm process and does not alone establish tornadogenesis. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: On the Rotation and Propagation of Simulated Supercell Thunderstorms
method: Three-dimensional cloud simulation
inputs: Environmental shear and simulated storm fields
target_and_horizon: Supercell rotation and propagation
summary: Examines how environmental shear, storm-generated vorticity and pressure forces contribute to supercell rotation and propagation.
summary_zh: 利用三维云模式分析环境切变、风暴内部生成的涡度和压强作用，解释超级单体的旋转与移动。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Parent-storm dynamics are context for tornado research, not tornado occurrence verification. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Severe Thunderstorm Evolution and Mesocyclone Structure as Related to Tornadogenesis
method: Conceptual storm model
inputs: Radar-derived storm structure and airflow
target_and_horizon: Mesocyclone evolution and tornadogenesis; retrospective
summary: Connects the evolution of severe-thunderstorm airflow and mesocyclone structure with tornadogenesis, a foundation for interpreting storm morphology.
summary_zh: 将强雷暴气流、中气旋结构的演变与龙卷生成联系起来，为传统风暴概念模型和雷达判读提供依据。
region: United States
caveat: A conceptual model should not be treated as a universal necessary-and-sufficient detection rule. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Hook Echoes and Rear-Flank Downdrafts: A Review
method: Review of observations and mechanisms
inputs: Hook-echo and rear-flank-downdraft literature
target_and_horizon: Tornadogenesis mechanisms and unresolved questions
summary: Reviews how hook echoes and rear-flank downdrafts relate to tornado formation, including the limits of available observations and conceptual explanations.
summary_zh: 综述钩状回波、后侧下沉气流与龙卷形成的关系，同时讨论观测不足及既有概念解释的局限。
region: Review
caveat: Review conclusions depend on the observations and simulations available at publication. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Direct Surface Thermodynamic Observations within the Rear-Flank Downdrafts of Nontornadic and Tornadic Supercells
method: Mobile-mesonet observational comparison
inputs: Near-surface thermodynamic observations and soundings
target_and_horizon: Tornadic versus nontornadic rear-flank downdrafts; retrospective
summary: Compares direct near-surface thermodynamic measurements in rear-flank downdrafts of tornadic and nontornadic supercells.
summary_zh: 比较有龙卷与无龙卷超级单体后侧下沉气流中的近地面热力观测，为判断冷池与龙卷生成的关系提供实测依据。
region: United States
caveat: Observational associations do not remove storm sampling and causal interpretation limits. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Numerical Simulation of Non-Supercell Tornadogenesis. Part I: Initiation and Evolution of Pretornadic Misocyclone Circulations along a Dry Outflow Boundary
method: High-resolution numerical simulation
inputs: Dry outflow boundary and environmental shear
target_and_horizon: Pretornadic misocyclone initiation and evolution
summary: Studies the development of small boundary vortices before non-supercell tornadogenesis using controlled dry-boundary simulations.
summary_zh: 在控制条件下模拟干出流边界上的小尺度涡旋形成与演变，补充非超级单体龙卷生成之前的动力过程。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Dry pretornadic boundary vortices are not yet fully developed moist-convective tornadoes. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Numerical Simulation of Nonsupercell Tornadogenesis. Part II: Evolution of a Family of Tornadoes along a Weak Outflow Boundary
method: Numerical non-supercell tornadogenesis
inputs: Weak outflow boundary and developing convection
target_and_horizon: Evolution of a family of simulated tornadoes
summary: Extends boundary-vortex simulations to the development of a tornado family along a weak outflow boundary.
summary_zh: 进一步研究弱出流边界上的龙卷群如何演变，补足以超级单体为中心的文献目录容易遗漏的生成机制。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: The simulated mechanism should not be assumed to describe every landspout or waterspout. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Low-Level Mesovortices within Squall Lines and Bow Echoes. Part I: Overview and Dependence on Environmental Shear
method: Idealized convective-line simulation
inputs: Environmental wind shear and simulated squall lines
target_and_horizon: Low-level QLCS mesovortices
summary: Examines low-level mesovortices in squall lines and bow echoes and their dependence on environmental shear.
summary_zh: 研究飑线和弓形回波中的低层中尺度涡旋及其对环境切变的响应，为理解QLCS龙卷的母体结构提供背景。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: A mesovortex in a convective line is not necessarily tornadic. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Tornadoes from Squall Lines and Bow Echoes. Part I: Climatological Distribution
method: Radar-based storm-mode climatology
inputs: U.S. tornado reports and radar reflectivity during 1998–2000
target_and_horizon: Tornado occurrence by parent-storm mode; retrospective
summary: Separates tornado reports by cellular, quasi-linear and other parent-storm modes to examine geographic, seasonal and daily differences.
summary_zh: 按单体、准线性对流系统等母体类型整理龙卷报告，比较其地域、季节和日变化特征。
region: Contiguous United States
caveat: Weak nocturnal events and storm-report incompleteness can bias storm-mode frequencies. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Life Cycle of Florida Keys' Waterspouts. I
method: Waterspout life-cycle observation
inputs: Florida Keys waterspout observations
target_and_horizon: Waterspout development stages; retrospective
summary: Describes stages in the life cycle of Florida Keys waterspouts, providing an observational entry point for tornadoes over water.
summary_zh: 描述佛罗里达群岛水龙卷生命周期中的不同阶段，为水面龙卷研究补充独立于陆地超级单体的观测入口。
region: Florida Keys, United States
caveat: Do not transfer one regional waterspout life cycle to every tornadic storm over water. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Simple Theory for Waterspouts
method: Thermodynamic waterspout theory
inputs: Idealized surface heat fluxes and convective vortex energetics
target_and_horizon: Waterspout intensity mechanisms
summary: Uses a heat-engine framework to interpret waterspout intensification and possible limits associated with surface fluxes and spray evaporation.
summary_zh: 用热机框架讨论水龙卷增强及其限制，联系海面通量、对流和水滴蒸发等过程。
region: Idealized theory
caveat: An idealized intensity argument is not a validated operational waterspout forecast. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Simulation and Analysis of Tornado Development and Decay within a Three-Dimensional Supercell Thunderstorm
method: Three-dimensional supercell simulation
inputs: High-resolution simulated storm fields
target_and_horizon: Tornado development and decay in a simulated storm
summary: Simulates tornado formation and decay within a three-dimensional supercell, allowing analysis of the storm-scale processes feeding the vortex.
summary_zh: 在三维超级单体模拟中研究龙卷形成与消散，追踪母体风暴如何影响近地面涡旋。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: A simulated tornado life cycle is not proof of real-time forecast performance. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Influence of Environmental Low-Level Shear and Cold Pools on Tornadogenesis: Insights from Idealized Simulations
method: Idealized heat-source and heat-sink experiments
inputs: Environmental low-level shear and controlled cold pools
target_and_horizon: Sensitivity of near-surface vortex formation
summary: Separates the roles of low-level shear and cooling in idealized supercell-like flows to study conditions favoring near-surface vortices.
summary_zh: 通过理想化加热与冷却试验分离低层切变和冷池的作用，分析有利于近地面强涡旋形成的条件。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Dry pseudostorm experiments isolate mechanisms rather than reproduce complete storms. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Imported and Storm-Generated Near-Ground Vertical Vorticity in a Simulated Supercell
method: Lagrangian vorticity decomposition
inputs: High-resolution simulated supercell and material trajectories
target_and_horizon: Sources of near-ground vertical vorticity
summary: Separates environmental and storm-generated contributions to near-ground vorticity using material trajectories through a simulated supercell.
summary_zh: 沿模拟中的流体轨迹分解环境输入涡度与风暴内部生成涡度，研究近地面垂直涡度的来源。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Vorticity-source conclusions depend on the simulated storm and trajectory analysis. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: An Idealized Numerical Simulation Investigation of the Effects of Surface Drag on the Development of Near-Surface Vertical Vorticity in Supercell Thunderstorms
method: Surface-drag sensitivity experiments
inputs: Idealized supercell simulations with contrasting boundary conditions
target_and_horizon: Contributions to near-surface vertical vorticity
summary: Investigates how surface drag changes the relative contributions of imported, baroclinic and frictionally generated vorticity.
summary_zh: 比较不同下边界条件下环境涡度、斜压生成涡度和摩擦生成涡度的贡献，补充地表拖曳对龙卷相关旋转的影响。
region: Idealized simulation
caveat: Surface drag and free-slip experiments represent different physical assumptions. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Simulated Supercells in Nontornadic and Tornadic VORTEX2 Environments
method: Paired idealized supercell simulations
inputs: Composite VORTEX2 tornadic and nontornadic soundings
target_and_horizon: Tornadogenesis versus failure under contrasting environments
summary: Uses observed composite environments to investigate why superficially similar supercells can differ in their low-level organization and tornado production.
summary_zh: 用VORTEX2合成环境驱动模拟，研究外观相似的超级单体为何会出现不同的低层组织结构和龙卷结果。
region: U.S. VORTEX2 environments
caveat: Composite-environment experiments do not provide population-wide tornado probabilities. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The National Severe Storms Laboratory Mesocyclone Detection Algorithm for the WSR-88D
method: Mesocyclone Detection Algorithm
inputs: WSR-88D radial-velocity features across space and time
target_and_horizon: Detection and diagnosis of storm-scale vortices
summary: Describes the NSSL MDA, including range-dependent thresholds, vertical and temporal associations, and neural diagnosis of vortex significance.
summary_zh: 介绍NSSL中气旋检测算法中的距离相关阈值、垂直与时间关联以及神经网络诊断，补齐业务涡旋检测算法的关键环节。
region: United States
caveat: Mesocyclone detection and the separate tornado detection algorithm have different targets. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Convective Modes for Significant Severe Thunderstorms in the Contiguous United States. Part I: Storm Classification and Climatology
method: Radar storm-mode classification
inputs: Volumetric radar and tornado/severe-storm reports during 2003–11
target_and_horizon: Convective-mode climatology; retrospective
summary: Builds a radar-based classification of storms associated with tornadoes and other significant severe-weather reports.
summary_zh: 依据体扫雷达对龙卷及其他显著强天气的母体风暴分类，提供比较不同对流组织类型的基础。
region: Contiguous United States
caveat: The event sample and grid-hour filtering define what the reported climatology represents. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Convective Modes for Significant Severe Thunderstorms in the Contiguous United States. Part II: Supercell and QLCS Tornado Environments
method: Environmental parameter comparison
inputs: Storm modes, report locations and SPC environmental analyses
target_and_horizon: Supercell versus QLCS tornado environments; retrospective
summary: Compares tornado environments across storm modes and seasons, connecting radar classifications with sounding-derived parameters.
summary_zh: 结合风暴类型与环境分析，比较超级单体和QLCS龙卷在不同季节的环境条件。
region: Contiguous United States
caveat: Thresholds estimated for one event archive need evaluation before regional transfer. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Effective Storm-Relative Helicity and Bulk Shear in Supercell Thunderstorm Environments
method: Effective-layer environmental diagnostics
inputs: RUC proximity soundings and radar-identified storm types
target_and_horizon: Environmental discrimination of storm and tornado categories
summary: Defines effective inflow-layer helicity and bulk shear to compare storm environments beyond fixed-height layers.
summary_zh: 用有效入流层定义螺旋度与整体切变，改进不同风暴环境之间的可比性，为传统龙卷潜势诊断提供依据。
region: United States
caveat: Environmental discrimination alone does not establish when or where a tornado will form. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Using Near-Ground Storm Relative Helicity in Supercell Tornado Forecasting
method: Near-ground helicity evaluation
inputs: Sounding-derived parameters for severe right-moving supercells
target_and_horizon: Discrimination of significant tornado environments
summary: Tests whether helicity in shallower near-ground layers improves discrimination of significantly tornadic supercells.
summary_zh: 检验近地面更浅气层的风暴相对螺旋度能否更好区分显著龙卷超级单体，连接物理机制与业务环境参数。
region: United States
caveat: Retrospective discrimination is not a stand-alone warning lead-time measurement. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: On Some Issues of United States Tornado Climatology
method: Critical tornado-climatology analysis
inputs: Historical U.S. tornado reports and rating practices
target_and_horizon: Biases and interpretation of tornado climatology
summary: Examines limitations in historical tornado reporting and intensity classification that affect climatological interpretation.
summary_zh: 讨论历史龙卷报告和强度分类中的局限，提醒读者将观测及评级制度变化与真实气候变化区分开来。
region: United States
caveat: Reporting and damage-rating changes can create artificial changes in occurrence statistics. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: On the implementation of the enhanced Fujita scale in the USA
method: Review of EF-scale implementation
inputs: Damage-based rating history and EF-scale practice
target_and_horizon: Interpretation and comparability of intensity ratings
summary: Discusses how implementing the Enhanced Fujita scale affects damage-based wind estimates and comparisons across time and place.
summary_zh: 讨论改进藤田等级实施后灾损风速估计及跨时期、跨地区比较的问题，帮助理解EF标签的生成条件。
region: United States
caveat: Damage indicators depend on exposed structures and construction practices. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Adjustments in Tornado Counts, F-Scale Intensity, and Path Width for Assessing Significant Tornado Destruction
venue: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology
method: Historical-record adjustment
inputs: Tornado counts, F/EF ratings and path-width records
target_and_horizon: Consistency of historical destruction indicators
summary: Examines inhomogeneities in counts, intensity ratings and path widths and proposes adjustments for historical comparison.
summary_zh: 检查龙卷个数、强度评级和路径宽度记录中的不一致，并讨论用于历史比较的调整办法。
region: United States
caveat: Adjusted records depend on methodological assumptions and are not direct wind measurements. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Diagnosing the Conditional Probability of Tornado Damage Rating Using Environmental and Radar Attributes
method: Conditional probability analysis
inputs: Peak low-level rotational velocity and near-storm environment
target_and_horizon: EF damage category conditional on a tornado; retrospective
summary: Relates radar rotation and environmental parameters to the conditional probability of higher tornado damage ratings.
summary_zh: 把雷达旋转速度和近风暴环境与更高灾损等级的条件概率联系起来，补充传统强度诊断方法。
region: Contiguous United States
caveat: Peak velocity over an event life span must not be treated as an input available before onset. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Prediction of Potential Tornado Damage Intensity Using Machine Learning
venue: Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
method: Comparison of nine ML classifiers
inputs: Pretornadic mesocyclone attributes and environmental analyses
target_and_horizon: Significant versus nonsignificant damage, conditional on tornadogenesis; radar about 30 min before onset
summary: Compares statistical and tree-based classifiers for potential tornado damage intensity using pre-onset radar and environmental predictors.
summary_zh: 以发生前的中气旋特征和环境分析比较多种分类器，预测在龙卷发生条件下的显著或非显著灾损强度。
region: United States
caveat: Conditioning on tornadogenesis differs from forecasting whether a tornado will occur. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Tornado Detection Using a Neuro–Fuzzy System to Integrate Shear and Spectral Signatures
venue: Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology
method: Neuro-fuzzy tornado detection
inputs: Doppler shear and spectral descriptors
target_and_horizon: Detection in the observed radar data
summary: Combines shear and spectral evidence through fuzzy membership functions refined by neural training.
summary_zh: 用神经训练调整模糊隶属函数，综合多普勒切变和频谱特征识别龙卷，补入深度学习之前的混合学习方法。
region: Oklahoma, United States
caveat: Evaluation on a small set of outbreaks does not establish nationwide operational performance. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Evaluation of Weather Radar with Pulse Compression: Performance of a Fuzzy Logic Tornado Detection Algorithm
venue: Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology
method: Pulse-compression and fuzzy-detection experiments
inputs: Simulated and experimental phase-coded radar data
target_and_horizon: Effect of radar waveform processing on tornado detection
summary: Examines whether pulse compression preserves tornado-detection information when a fuzzy-logic detector processes the resulting radar data.
summary_zh: 研究脉冲压缩处理如何影响模糊逻辑龙卷检测，补充雷达波形与信号处理对识别能力的影响。
region: Radar simulation and experimental observations
caveat: This evaluates a sensing and processing configuration, not a universal detector. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Support vector machines for spatiotemporal tornado prediction
method: Support vector machines
inputs: Spatiotemporal Doppler-radar-derived predictors
target_and_horizon: Tornado probability classification in space and time
summary: Applies support vector machines to spatiotemporal tornado prediction, providing a classical alternative to neural-network classifiers.
summary_zh: 将支持向量机用于龙卷时空预测，为神经网络以外的传统机器学习方法提供代表文献。
region: United States
caveat: Check the exact event window and data split in the primary paper before comparing scores. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Application of Random Forest Algorithm on Tornado Detection
method: Random forest tornado detection
inputs: CINRAD-SA velocity, reflectivity and spectrum-width features
target_and_horizon: Tornado identification from radar observations
summary: Develops TDA-RF using Chinese radar observations and tests it on later tornado cases with a range of intensities and radar distances.
summary_zh: 利用中国雷达的速度、反射率和谱宽特征构建TDA-RF，并在后续不同强度、不同探测距离的龙卷个例上测试。
region: China
caveat: A limited set of held-out tornado cases is not nationwide operational validation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Machine learning classification of significant tornadoes and hail in the U.S. using ERA5 proximity soundings
method: Environmental ML classification
inputs: ERA5 profiles near tornado and hail reports
target_and_horizon: Severe versus significant-severe event classification
summary: Compares classifiers using reanalysis proximity profiles to distinguish significant tornado and hail reports from less severe reports.
summary_zh: 用事件附近的ERA5垂直廓线比较分类器，区分普通强天气与显著龙卷、冰雹事件。
region: United States
caveat: Event-conditioned reanalysis classification differs from prospective warning with operational inputs. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Improve Real-Time Decision-Making for High-Impact Weather
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Review and application synthesis
inputs: AI methods, observations and numerical guidance
target_and_horizon: Decision support for multiple high-impact weather hazards
summary: Connects machine learning with physical understanding and forecaster decision support across high-impact weather applications.
summary_zh: 梳理机器学习、物理认识与预报决策支持的关系，为评价龙卷智能方法提供强天气业务背景。
region: Multiple weather applications
caveat: Results across different hazards must not be pooled into a tornado-specific skill claim. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Multi‐Task Learning for Tornado Identification Using Doppler Radar Data
method: Multi-task identification network (MTI-Net)
inputs: Doppler weather-radar data
target_and_horizon: Tornado detection and count estimation
summary: Jointly learns tornado identification and count estimation with attention-based spatial and variable interactions.
summary_zh: 通过空间与通道注意力联合学习龙卷识别和数量估计，补入中国雷达深度学习研究中的MTI-Net方法。
region: China
caveat: Detection, count estimation and forecast lead time are distinct tasks. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Enhancing multi-task learning-based Tornado identification using spatial and temporal information from weather radar images
method: TS-MTINet spatiotemporal multi-task learning
inputs: Time sequences of weather-radar images
target_and_horizon: Tornado identification and number estimation
summary: Extends multi-task tornado identification by incorporating temporal evolution alongside spatial radar information.
summary_zh: 在多任务龙卷识别中加入雷达图像的时间演变信息，连接单时刻空间识别与连续观测建模。
region: China
caveat: Temporal inputs do not by themselves establish a causal forecast horizon. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Dual-polarization radar-based enhanced tornado detection network with explainability analysis
method: Enhanced dual-polarization detection with explainability
inputs: Dual-polarization radar observations
target_and_horizon: Radar-based tornado detection
summary: Combines a dual-polarization tornado detection network with analysis of the evidence used by the model.
summary_zh: 将双偏振雷达龙卷检测网络与模型解释分析结合，补充较新的专用识别方法。
region: China
caveat: Attribution analysis does not prove the model learned a physically causal mechanism. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Analysis of Generalization Performance of Tornado Detection Models: A Cross-Domain Evaluation from U.S. to Chinese Weather Radar Observations
method: Zero-shot cross-country model evaluation
inputs: U.S. TorNet training data and Chinese CINRAD observations
target_and_horizon: Transfer of tornado detectors from the United States to China
summary: Evaluates how tornado detectors trained on U.S. radar data behave on Chinese observations and investigates sources of degraded detection.
summary_zh: 检验在美国TorNet上训练的检测器迁移到中国CINRAD后的表现，分析雷达系统、旋转特征和数据质量差异。
region: United States and China
caveat: Source-domain skill must not be reported as target-domain skill. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A hybrid physics-informed graph neural network for tornado wind-field modeling
method: Physics-informed graph neural network
inputs: Analytical vortex representation and high-fidelity wind-field information
target_and_horizon: Tornado wind-field modeling
summary: Combines an analytical tornado representation with a physics-informed graph model to represent wind-field structure.
summary_zh: 将解析龙卷模型与物理约束图神经网络结合，用于描述龙卷风场结构，扩展智能方法在风工程中的应用范围。
region: Wind-field modeling
caveat: Wind-field reconstruction or emulation is distinct from predicting tornado onset. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Convective-Scale Warn-on-Forecast System
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Warn-on-Forecast research vision
inputs: Rapid observations, data assimilation and convection-scale ensembles
target_and_horizon: Proposed warning guidance from numerical prediction
summary: Sets out a convection-scale Warn-on-Forecast vision connecting rapid observations, assimilation and ensemble prediction.
summary_zh: 提出对流尺度Warn-on-Forecast研究路线，将快速观测、资料同化和集合预测用于未来预警指导。
region: United States
caveat: This is a research vision, not evidence that the proposed system had already achieved its targets. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Forecasting Tornadoes Using Convection-Permitting Ensembles
method: Convection-permitting ensemble postprocessing
inputs: Simulated updraft helicity and environmental fields
target_and_horizon: Daily probabilistic tornado guidance
summary: Constructs tornado probabilities from convection-permitting ensembles using simulated rotation proxies and environmental constraints.
summary_zh: 结合允许对流集合模式中的上升气流螺旋度与环境条件构建龙卷概率指导，补充传统数值预测路线。
region: United States
caveat: Updraft helicity is a proxy for storm rotation, not a resolved tornado. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Spatial trends in United States tornado frequency
method: Spatial trend analysis
inputs: Tornado reports and significant-tornado environmental parameter
target_and_horizon: Regional changes in tornado frequency since 1979
summary: Examines spatially differing trends in tornado reports together with an environmental covariate.
summary_zh: 将龙卷报告与环境协变量结合，研究美国不同地区龙卷频率的变化，避免只用全国总数概括区域差异。
region: United States
caveat: Report trends and environmental trends do not alone establish causal climate attribution. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Tornado Climatology of Poland
method: Historical and modern event climatology
inputs: European Severe Weather Database and historical Polish reports
target_and_horizon: Tornado and waterspout occurrence in Poland
summary: Combines historical and recent records to describe Polish tornado seasonality, geography and intensity categories.
summary_zh: 整理波兰历史及近期龙卷、水龙卷记录，描述季节、地域和强度分布并讨论资料问题。
region: Poland
caveat: Reporting completeness differs between historical and contemporary periods. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Robust increases in severe thunderstorm environments in response to greenhouse forcing
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
method: Climate-model environmental analysis
inputs: Global climate-model ensemble and severe-storm environment diagnostics
target_and_horizon: Future changes in severe-thunderstorm environments
summary: Investigates how greenhouse forcing changes environments favorable for severe thunderstorms and potentially tornadic storms.
summary_zh: 分析温室气体强迫下有利于强雷暴及潜在龙卷风暴的环境如何变化，补充气候背景研究。
region: United States
caveat: Changes in favorable environments are not direct forecasts of tornado counts. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Spatial and Temporal Analysis of Tornado Fatalities in the United States: 1880–2005
method: Spatial vulnerability and fatality analysis
inputs: Fatal tornado records, demographics and exposure indicators
target_and_horizon: Fatality patterns during 1880–2005; retrospective
summary: Studies where fatal tornadoes occur and how physical hazards and social vulnerability jointly shape the observed patterns.
summary_zh: 分析致命龙卷的时空分布，讨论物理危险、人口暴露和社会脆弱性如何共同影响伤亡。
region: United States
caveat: Observed vulnerability associations do not determine an individual event outcome. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: WSR-88D Radar, Tornado Warnings, and Tornado Casualties
method: Observational regression analysis
inputs: Radar-installation timing, tornado warnings and casualty records
target_and_horizon: Association of WSR-88D deployment with warnings and casualties
summary: Examines changes in warning performance and tornado casualties around the installation of WSR-88D radar.
summary_zh: 结合雷达安装时间、预警及伤亡记录，研究WSR-88D部署前后预警表现和人员伤亡的变化。
region: United States
caveat: An observational before/after analysis depends on controls and other contemporaneous changes. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: TORNADO-WARNING PERFORMANCE IN THE PAST AND FUTURE: A Perspective from Signal Detection Theory
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Signal-detection-theory analysis
inputs: Historical tornado-warning performance
target_and_horizon: Tradeoffs between warning detection and false alarms
summary: Interprets tornado-warning performance through signal detection theory to explain why changing decision thresholds creates tradeoffs.
summary_zh: 用信号检测理论解释龙卷预警的命中与虚警权衡，为评价算法阈值和预警系统改进提供基础。
region: United States
caveat: Lower false-alarm ratio alone is insufficient evidence of a better warning system. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: False Alarms, Tornado Warnings, and Tornado Casualties
method: Casualty regression with warning statistics
inputs: Regional false-alarm ratios and tornado casualties
target_and_horizon: False-alarm association with casualties; retrospective
summary: Examines whether areas with different warning false-alarm histories have different tornado casualty outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究不同地区的预警虚警历史与龙卷伤亡结果之间的关联，补充预警对公众影响的文献。
region: United States
caveat: Regional observational associations are not a direct experiment on individual protective behavior. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Low-Frequency Atmospheric Acoustic Energy Associated with Vortices Produced by Thunderstorms
method: Infrasound and radar comparison
inputs: Low-frequency acoustic observations and radar storm kinematics
target_and_horizon: Acoustic evidence associated with tornadic vortices
summary: Compares low-frequency acoustic observations with radar-diagnosed storm circulations to investigate possible tornado-related signals.
summary_zh: 将低频声学观测与雷达风暴环流进行比较，探索与龙卷涡旋有关的次声信号。
region: United States
caveat: Atmospheric propagation and competing sound sources complicate detection and localization. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Measurement and characterization of infrasound from a tornado producing storm
venue: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
method: Infrasound field measurement
inputs: Microphone-array observations near a tornado-producing storm
target_and_horizon: Characterization of storm-related infrasound
summary: Characterizes acoustic signals associated with a tornado-producing storm while examining wind-noise contamination and source direction.
summary_zh: 分析产龙卷风暴附近的次声信号，同时考察风噪污染和声源方向，补充新型观测证据。
region: Oklahoma, United States
caveat: A storm-associated acoustic signal is not automatically a unique tornado signature. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Insight into the Kinematic and Microphysical Processes that Control Lightning Jumps
method: Lightning-jump process analysis
inputs: Total lightning, polarimetric radar and multi-Doppler observations
target_and_horizon: Storm updraft and microphysical changes associated with lightning jumps
summary: Connects lightning jumps with changes in storm updrafts and graupel, clarifying the physical meaning of a potential severe-storm predictor.
summary_zh: 结合闪电与雷达观测解释闪电跃增对应的上升气流和霰变化，补充多源强天气监测的物理背景。
region: United States
caveat: Lightning jumps indicate storm evolution and are not tornado-specific confirmation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Objective Satellite-Based Detection of Overshooting Tops Using Infrared Window Channel Brightness Temperature Gradients
venue: Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology
method: Infrared overshooting-top detection
inputs: Satellite infrared brightness temperatures and tropopause forecast
target_and_horizon: Detection of overshooting convective cloud tops
summary: Detects overshooting tops from infrared texture and environmental information, supplying satellite context for severe-storm monitoring.
summary_zh: 从红外亮温纹理和对流层顶信息识别过冲云顶，为龙卷相关强风暴监测提供卫星观测背景。
region: Satellite observations and simulation
caveat: Overshooting tops can accompany several hazards and do not uniquely identify tornadoes. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The LaGrange Tornado during VORTEX2. Part II: Photogrammetric Analysis of the Tornado Combined with Dual-Doppler Radar Data
method: Photogrammetry and dual-Doppler synthesis
inputs: Cloud photographs and dual-Doppler radar
target_and_horizon: Relationship between visible funnel and tornado circulation; retrospective
summary: Combines photography and radar to examine how the visible funnel relates to the tornado and its parent circulation.
summary_zh: 将云体摄影测量与双多普勒雷达结合，比较可见漏斗与龙卷环流、中气旋的对应关系。
region: Wyoming, United States
caveat: A visible funnel and damaging near-surface circulation need not begin at the same time. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Near-Ground Pressure and Wind Measurements in Tornadoes
method: In-situ tornado intercept measurements
inputs: Pressure probes, video and mobile-mesonet wind observations
target_and_horizon: Near-ground tornado pressure and wind structure
summary: Reports rare near-ground pressure and wind observations obtained during tornado intercepts across several events.
summary_zh: 整理多次龙卷近地面压强及风场实测，为雷达推断、实验室模拟和风工程研究提供观测参照。
region: United States
caveat: Sparse intercept measurements do not sample every part of a tornado wind field. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Finescale Radar Observations of the Dimmitt, Texas (2 June 1995), Tornado
method: Mobile Doppler radar case study
inputs: Doppler on Wheels volumetric observations
target_and_horizon: Fine-scale tornado structure and evolution
summary: Uses close-range mobile radar to document the evolving three-dimensional structure of the Dimmitt tornado.
summary_zh: 利用近距离车载多普勒雷达观测Dimmitt龙卷的三维细尺度结构与演变，补充固定站雷达以外的测量路线。
region: Texas, United States
caveat: Radar sampling geometry and measured height limit interpretation of surface peak wind. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Satellite-based identification of tornado damage tracks from the 27 April 2011 severe weather outbreak
method: Satellite damage-track mapping
inputs: Post-event satellite observations
target_and_horizon: Identification of tornado damage tracks after an outbreak
summary: Investigates satellite identification of tornado damage tracks following the 27 April 2011 outbreak.
summary_zh: 研究如何从卫星观测中识别2011年4月27日龙卷爆发后的灾损路径，补入传统遥感灾后制图方法。
region: United States
caveat: Post-event track mapping is separate from detecting tornado onset. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Advances in deep learning applications to severe convective weather forecasting: rainstorms, hail, thunderstorm winds and tornadoes
method: Deep-learning review
inputs: Literature on rainstorms, hail, thunderstorm wind and tornadoes
target_and_horizon: Survey of severe-convective forecasting methods
summary: Reviews deep-learning approaches across four severe-convective hazards and discusses data, physical constraints and interpretability limitations.
summary_zh: 综述暴雨、冰雹、雷暴大风和龙卷的深度学习方法，讨论数据、物理约束和可解释性方面的限制。
region: Review
caveat: Evidence for one hazard cannot be used as validation for another. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A review of the characteristics of tornadic wind fields through observations and simulations
venue: Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics
method: Observation and wind-engineering review
inputs: Measured, laboratory and simulated tornadic wind fields
target_and_horizon: Interpretation of wind-field structure and intensity
summary: Reviews tornado wind-field characteristics across observations and simulations, including how intensity relates to damage and engineering representations.
summary_zh: 综合观测、实验室和数值模拟中的龙卷风场特征，讨论强度、灾损与工程表示之间的关系。
region: Review
caveat: Simulation fidelity and damage-based wind inference carry different uncertainties. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Century of Progress in Severe Convective Storm Research and Forecasting
method: Historical review
inputs: Severe-storm observation, theory and forecasting literature
target_and_horizon: Evolution of severe-convective research and operations
summary: Traces how observing systems, physical understanding and numerical prediction changed severe-storm research and forecasting.
summary_zh: 回顾观测系统、物理认识和数值预测如何推动强对流研究与业务演进，为从传统方法读到智能方法建立时间脉络。
region: International review
caveat: This broad historical review does not replace tornado-specific validation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Second Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment: VORTEX2
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Multi-platform field-campaign overview
inputs: Mobile radars, mesonets, soundings, photography and damage surveys
target_and_horizon: Observation of tornado formation, maintenance and decay
summary: Documents the VORTEX2 campaign design and its coordinated observations of tornadoes, parent storms and near-storm environments.
summary_zh: 介绍VORTEX2多平台外场试验及其对龙卷、母体风暴和环境的协同观测，补充基准数据背后的观测来源。
region: United States
caveat: A field-campaign overview is not a single harmonized machine-learning dataset. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment: VORTEX
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Field-experiment design
inputs: Coordinated mobile and fixed storm observations
target_and_horizon: Investigation of the origins of rotation in tornadoes
summary: Describes the original VORTEX experiment and the measurements needed to investigate tornado formation.
summary_zh: 介绍最初VORTEX试验的研究设计和观测需求，为理解龙卷生成研究的实测证据来源提供入口。
region: United States
caveat: A campaign-design paper does not imply that every planned scientific question was resolved. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Mesoscale‐to‐LES Modeling of Tornado‐Like Vortex and Associated Local Strong Winds in Urban Area
method: Mesoscale-to-large-eddy simulation
inputs: Nested storm simulation and explicit urban building geometry
target_and_horizon: Urban modification of a tornado-like vortex and local winds
summary: Resolves a tornado-like vortex interacting with building clusters to examine changes in vortex structure and local strong winds.
summary_zh: 在嵌套模拟中显式描述龙卷状涡旋与建筑群的相互作用，研究城市建筑如何改变涡旋结构和局地强风。
region: South China
caveat: Simulation of an urban case does not establish a general building-level risk forecast. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Improving the prediction of the 3 July 2019 Kaiyuan tornadic supercell and embedded tornado with radar and surface data assimilation
venue: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society
method: Radar and surface data assimilation with nested WRF
inputs: Seven operational radars and dense surface observations
target_and_horizon: Simulation of the 2019 Kaiyuan supercell and embedded tornado
summary: Tests assimilation of radar and surface observations and nests a tornado-resolving simulation within a supercell forecast.
summary_zh: 检验雷达与地面观测同化对2019年开原超级单体预测的影响，并嵌套能够解析龙卷的高分辨率模拟。
region: Liaoning, China
caveat: A selected-case simulation and assimilation sensitivity experiment is not population-wide forecast validation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Long-Term Performance Metrics for National Weather Service Tornado Warnings
method: Long-term warning verification
inputs: NWS tornado warnings and observed events
target_and_horizon: Lead time and advance-warning fraction across policy changes
summary: Uses consistent metrics to compare tornado-warning performance across changes in warning and verification practices.
summary_zh: 用一致的指标比较预警及检验制度变化前后的龙卷预警表现，避免将口径变化误认为能力变化。
region: United States
caveat: Metric definitions and policy changes must be checked before comparing warning eras. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: The Finley Affair: A Signal Event in the History of Forecast Verification
method: Historical forecast-verification analysis
inputs: Finley tornado forecasts and contemporary critiques
target_and_horizon: Rare-event forecast verification and skill interpretation
summary: Revisits the Finley tornado-forecast debate to explain the origins of forecast verification and the pitfalls of raw accuracy for rare events.
summary_zh: 回顾Finley龙卷预报争论，说明预报检验的历史来源以及罕见事件中仅看准确率的缺陷。
region: United States historical forecasts
caveat: High accuracy can result from predicting the common non-event class. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 中国当代强对流天气研究与业务进展
venue: 气象学报 / Acta Meteorologica Sinica
method: Review of Chinese severe-convective research and operations
inputs: Storm observations, environmental diagnostics and forecasting literature
target_and_horizon: Historical and contemporary severe-weather research
summary: Reviews severe-convective science and operations in China, including tornado environments, radar recognition and forecasting approaches.
summary_zh: 梳理中国强对流研究与业务进展，包含龙卷环境、雷达识别及预报方法，为阅读中文龙卷文献提供综述入口。
region: China
caveat: Severe-convective findings are broader than tornado-specific validation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 冷涡背景下辽宁龙卷气候特征和环境条件
venue: 气象学报 / Acta Meteorologica Sinica
method: Cold-vortex environment and climatology analysis
inputs: 1951–2020 tornado observations, damage records and ERA5
target_and_horizon: Occurrence and intensity-group environments; retrospective
summary: Examines Liaoning tornadoes associated with cold vortices and compares environmental parameters between intensity groups.
summary_zh: 整理1951—2020年冷涡背景下辽宁龙卷记录，并比较不同强度组的环境参数，补充东北地区龙卷研究。
region: Liaoning, China
caveat: The journal issue is 2022 despite the 2021 DOI suffix and online date; regional thresholds need local evaluation. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 雷达资料同化对2016年6月23日阜宁龙卷模拟的改进
venue: 气象学报 / Acta Meteorologica Sinica
method: Radar data assimilation and numerical sensitivity experiments
inputs: Reflectivity, radial velocity and surface observations
target_and_horizon: Simulation of the 2016 Funing tornadic storm
summary: Tests how assimilating radar observations changes the simulation of the Funing tornado-producing storm.
summary_zh: 通过数值试验比较雷达资料同化对阜宁龙卷风暴模拟的影响，补充中国典型个例的数值预测文献。
region: Jiangsu, China
caveat: A retrospective assimilation experiment does not establish general operational lead time. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 台风“艾云尼”（2018）外围两次近距离龙卷的环境条件和雷达特征
venue: 热带气象学报 / Journal of Tropical Meteorology
method: Multi-radar observational case analysis
inputs: X- and S-band dual-polarization radar, wind profilers and surface stations
target_and_horizon: Typhoon-associated tornado environments and radar signatures
summary: Compares two tornadoes near Typhoon Ewiniar using radar networks and environmental observations, including limitations in debris-signature detection.
summary_zh: 利用多波段雷达、风廓线和地面观测分析艾云尼外围两次龙卷，讨论微型超级单体特征及碎片特征未被捕捉的情况。
region: Guangdong, China
caveat: Individual case precursor times are not general warning lead-time estimates. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 2023年江苏阜宁EF3级龙卷分析与多波段雷达监测预警技术Ⅰ：天气分析与多波段雷达观测
venue: 热带气象学报 / Journal of Tropical Meteorology
method: Multi-band radar case study
inputs: Environmental analyses, damage survey and multi-band radar observations
target_and_horizon: Analysis of the 19 September 2023 Funing tornado
summary: Combines event and environmental analysis with multi-band radar observations of the 2023 Funing EF3 tornado.
summary_zh: 结合灾情、天气背景和多波段雷达观测分析2023年阜宁EF3龙卷，补充近期国内协同观测文献。
region: Jiangsu, China
caveat: This is Part I of a case-study series; publication year differs from event year. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: 一次关于龙卷的天气雷达识别技术研究
venue: 运筹与模糊学 / Operations Research and Fuzziology
method: Mesocyclone identification and DBSCAN storm clustering
inputs: Single- and dual-polarization radar variables
target_and_horizon: Radar identification in selected tornado cases
summary: Combines mesocyclone recognition with clustered storm-cell features in radar case studies.
summary_zh: 结合中气旋识别与DBSCAN单体聚类，在阜宁和三水龙卷资料中研究联合识别方法。
region: China
caveat: Limited case studies and a venue label do not establish an independently benchmarked detector. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Creating spatio-temporal tornado probability forecasts using fuzzy logic and motion variability
venue: AMS Fifth Conference on Artificial Intelligence Applications to Environmental Science
method: Fuzzy logic and motion-uncertainty modeling
inputs: Radar low-level shear, reflectivity and storm-motion estimates
target_and_horizon: Spatial tornado probability at a future time window
summary: Combines candidate-region motion uncertainty with fuzzy tornado potential to construct a spatiotemporal probability field.
summary_zh: 将候选区域的运动不确定性与模糊逻辑龙卷潜势结合，构建未来时间窗的时空概率场。
region: United States
caveat: The conference abstract explicitly says the proposed neural probability training had not yet been developed. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: TornadoNet: Real-Time Building Damage Detection with Ordinal Supervision
method: Object detection with ordinal supervision
inputs: Geotagged street-level building imagery
target_and_horizon: Post-tornado building localization and ordered damage states
summary: Benchmarks CNN and transformer detectors with ordinal damage supervision on street-level imagery from the 2021 Midwest tornado outbreak.
summary_zh: 在2021年美国中西部龙卷灾后街景中比较卷积与Transformer检测器，并研究有序损伤监督对建筑检测和分级的影响。
region: United States
caveat: Building damage states are not EF tornado ratings; real-time inference is not tornado prediction. Publication status is verified only through the cited preprint. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: From Pixels to Semantics: A Multi-Stage AI Framework for Structural Damage Detection in Satellite Imagery
method: Super-resolution, object detection and vision-language interpretation
inputs: Pre- and post-disaster satellite imagery
target_and_horizon: Post-event building-damage detection and semantic interpretation
summary: Combines image enhancement, object detection and a vision-language stage for damage interpretation, with experiments including a tornado-event subset.
summary_zh: 将图像增强、目标检测和视觉语言解释结合，用于灾后建筑损伤分析，实验包含龙卷事件子集。
region: U.S. tornado and hurricane subsets
caveat: CVF workshop publication and arXiv:2603.22768 identify the same work, counted once. Mixed-disaster test imagery and generated descriptions do not establish general tornado reasoning or physical localization accuracy. No independent reproduction.

title: Quantum-Grassmann-Plucker Token Mixing for Deep Learning-Based Post-Disaster Damage Assessment
method: Geometric and quantum-inspired token mixing
inputs: Paired pre/post-event satellite image patches from xBD tornado events
target_and_horizon: Post-event building-damage classification with an unseen-event evaluation
summary: Compares geometric and quantum-inspired token-mixing heads on paired tornado-damage imagery, including an event held out from development.
summary_zh: 在龙卷灾前灾后卫星图像上比较几何及量子启发的特征混合方法，并设置未参与开发的事件进行评估。
region: Joplin, Moore and Tuscaloosa, United States
caveat: The quantum circuit is simulated; this is not a claim of demonstrated quantum-hardware advantage. Preprint results have not been independently reproduced. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Radar Records Illinois Tornadogenesis
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
method: Conventional radar case observation
inputs: Radar echo sequence and tornado observations
target_and_horizon: Observed tornado association; retrospective
summary: An early record connecting a hook-shaped radar echo with an Illinois tornado, anchoring the observational lineage before Doppler algorithms.
summary_zh: 记录伊利诺伊州龙卷与钩状雷达回波的对应关系，为追溯多普勒算法出现以前的龙卷识别方法提供原始文献。
region: Illinois, United States
caveat: The DOI describes the correspondence section rather than the individual letter; the title and authors are identified in the AMS Centennial Monograph bibliography. A historical case does not establish detection sensitivity or specificity. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A note on the shear-forced dynamics of tornadoes
method: Axisymmetric viscous vortex theory
inputs: Prescribed incompressible circulation and internal vertical wind shear
target_and_horizon: Structural change and decay of an idealized tornado-like vortex
summary: Derives an idealized shear-forced vortex solution and studies how internal vertical shear changes the radius and decay of the rotating core.
summary_zh: 推导受内部垂直切变作用的理想化涡旋解，讨论切变如何改变旋转核心的半径、垂直结构和衰减。
region: Idealized theory
caveat: Preprint; the prescribed axisymmetric flow is a mechanism study, not an operational tornado lifetime forecast. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment
method: Interactive segmentation and foundation-model embeddings
inputs: Post-disaster satellite imagery, building footprints and analyst labels
target_and_horizon: Rapid post-event building-damage mapping
summary: Presents a web platform for scene-specific segmentation or embedding-based damage classification, with reported response use across disasters including tornadoes.
summary_zh: 提供基于场景分割或基础模型特征的交互式建筑灾损制图平台，作者报告的应用灾种包含龙卷。
region: Multi-hazard applications
caveat: Preprint; operational examples and aggregate xBD experiments are not a separate tornado-only performance benchmark. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Can hot water discharged from industrial processes enhance the likelihood of waterspouts?
method: High-resolution numerical case studies and SST sensitivity experiments
inputs: Limited-area weather model, event reports and coastal sea-surface-temperature perturbations
target_and_horizon: Waterspout environments and sensitivity to industrial warm-water discharge
summary: Reconstructs four Italian waterspout environments and tests whether a localized warm-water discharge changes selected atmospheric precursors.
summary_zh: 重建意大利四次水龙卷的天气环境，并通过海温敏感性试验研究局部工业温排水对环境前兆的影响。
region: Northern Tyrrhenian coast, Italy
caveat: Preprint; case-specific environmental responses do not constitute direct resolution of every waterspout or a general industrial causal attribution. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Two-Stage Bayesian Framework for Multi-Fidelity Online Updating of Spatial Fragility Fields
method: Bayesian multi-fidelity updating and Gaussian processes
inputs: Wind-field priors, computer-vision damage observations and building characteristics
target_and_horizon: Updating spatial building-fragility fields after a tornado
summary: Fuses physics-based fragility priors with damage observations of varying reliability, demonstrated on the 2011 Joplin tornado.
summary_zh: 将物理易损性先验与不同可靠程度的灾损观测结合，以2011年乔普林龙卷为例更新建筑易损性空间分布。
region: Joplin, United States
caveat: Explicitly non-peer-reviewed preprint; posterior uncertainty depends on observation fidelity and wind-field assumptions. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: A Comparative Multi-Hazard Risk Assessment of the US High-Voltage Transmission Network
method: Multi-hazard fragility and economic-impact modeling
inputs: Hazard datasets and U.S. transmission lines and substations
target_and_horizon: Comparative infrastructure exposure and modeled downstream losses
summary: Compares tornado risk with other hazards using a common transmission-network fragility and economic-impact framework.
summary_zh: 以统一的输电网络易损性与经济影响框架比较龙卷和其他灾害风险，扩展基础设施影响方向的文献。
region: United States
caveat: Preprint; the authors describe modeled losses as first-order bounding estimates, not observed losses or forecasts of a specific event. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: XWOD: A Real-World Benchmark for Object Detection under Extreme Weather Conditions
method: Extreme-weather traffic-object detection benchmark
inputs: Real-world traffic images labeled with weather conditions, including tornadoes
target_and_horizon: Detection of road users and vehicles in adverse-weather imagery
summary: Introduces a traffic-object benchmark whose weather taxonomy includes tornado scenes, useful for separating weather robustness from tornado recognition.
summary_zh: 发布包含龙卷场景标签的恶劣天气交通目标检测基准，可用于研究灾害环境中的视觉鲁棒性。
region: Multi-region imagery
caveat: Preprint; targets are traffic objects, not tornado boxes, radar signatures or EF intensity labels. Aggregate transfer results are not tornado detection accuracy. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Singular stationary Navier-Stokes flows: examples and stability
method: Analysis of singular stationary Navier–Stokes flows
inputs: Idealized steady flows in domains with boundaries
target_and_horizon: Structure and stability of mathematical vortices related to Serrin swirling flows
summary: Studies singular steady flows and their stability, including swirling-vortex examples with qualitative features resembling tornado circulation.
summary_zh: 研究有边界区域中奇异定常流的结构与稳定性，其中旋转涡流示例与龙卷环流具有部分定性相似特征。
region: Mathematical theory
caveat: Preprint; qualitative tornado-like structure is physical context, not validation against observed atmospheric tornadoes. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

title: Baseline Climatology of Tornadoes and Waterspouts in the Philippine Archipelago
method: Regional climatology and proximity-sounding analysis
inputs: Philippine tornado/waterspout reports and ERA5 soundings
target_and_horizon: Historical occurrence and tropical-maritime environmental diagnostics
summary: Compiles Philippine tornado and waterspout reports and examines whether midlatitude environmental parameters describe their tropical-maritime settings.
summary_zh: 汇集菲律宾龙卷和水龙卷报告，并结合ERA5探空检验中纬度环境参数在热带海洋环境中的适用性。
region: Philippines
caveat: Preprint; mixed tornado/waterspout reports and historical reporting biases must be considered before interpreting regional rates or predictor thresholds. Metadata/abstract-level review; experiments not independently reproduced.

summary_zh: 结合灾害年鉴与CFSR再分析资料，比较中国三个龙卷多发区的时空分布、环流背景和环境参数差异。
region: China
caveat: Historical reports are incomplete and region-dependent. Composite environmental associations are not a prospective classifier or universally calibrated warning threshold.

title: 龙卷数值模拟研究进展
method: Review of idealized and real-case numerical simulations
inputs: Published vortex, supercell and data-assimilation studies
target_and_horizon: Simulation mechanisms and limitations; no common forecast horizon
summary: Reviews simplified vortices, sounding-initialized storm simulations and real-case modeling, with attention to turbulence, sensitivity and debris.
summary_zh: 梳理简化涡旋、理想化超级单体及真实个例三类模拟，讨论湍流、敏感性、残骸和生成机制等问题。
region: Global methods with Chinese research context
caveat: A review organizes prior work; it does not establish a single validated tornado-warning model. DOI was not verified from the cited institutional journal page.

title: 2025年中国龙卷活动及灾情特征
method: Annual multi-source event inventory
inputs: Damage surveys, radar and other event evidence
target_and_horizon: Retrospective 2025 Chinese tornado activity and damage characteristics
summary: Synthesizes multiple observation sources into an annual account of Chinese land tornadoes and waterspouts, including sampling limitations.
summary_zh: 综合多源信息回顾2025年中国陆龙卷、水龙卷和灾情特征，并讨论弱龙卷遗漏及调查覆盖不足。
region: China
caveat: Published 20 June 2026 in volume 16, issue 3. Annual reported counts are affected by observation and reporting coverage; they are not a complete physical event census. No DOI was supplied on the checked journal page.

title: 豫东北三次龙卷环流背景、环境条件和雷达特征分析
method: Comparative synoptic and radar case analysis
inputs: Conventional observations, ERA5 reanalysis and Doppler radar
target_and_horizon: Diagnostic characteristics of three historical tornado episodes
summary: Compares environments and radar signatures in three northeastern Henan tornado cases to inform local warning diagnosis.
summary_zh: 结合常规观测、ERA5和多普勒雷达，对比豫东北三次龙卷过程，归纳本地监测预警的诊断线索。
region: Northeastern Henan, China
caveat: Online publication 6 July 2026; DOI contains the submission-year identifier 2025. Three retrospective cases do not establish general prospective detection or forecast skill.
